description.p: TSCR – Top Secret Chrono Crypt is a proprietary, multi-platform, local-first hybrid cybersecurity and cryptography solution for protecting text, files, folders, keys, passwords, tokens, notes, and other personal or business secrets.

TSCR combines an original chrono-entropic protection architecture, multiple encryption profiles, Secret Vault workflows, secure-value generation, integrity tools, multilingual support, desktop integration, controlled licensing, and protected-runtime mechanisms in one environment.

ul.li: TSCR, TOP SECRET, and TSCR AES protection profiles
Encryption and decryption of text, files, and folders
Secret Vault workflows for credentials, keys, notes, payment data, and personal secrets
Secret Generator and Estimator for entropy calculation, strength evaluation, and estimated cracking time
Hash, ZIP, UnZIP, system-information, update, and integrity-oriented tools
Multilingual runtime with TSCR-AI language and passphrase-dictionary expansion

description.p: The term “Top Secret” is the product and security-profile name and does not represent a claim of government classification or certification.
